descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
QualityAI is the leading AI-first quality engineering company. 
 We deliver end-to-end quality management services across the business and technology life cycle for enterprise customers who need certainty at Go-Live. 
 We build and test services and products using AI, working across data, models, platforms, devices, and infrastructure to ensure those systems perform as expected at scale. 
 About the Role: 
 We are looking for a Technical Automation Lead to join our engineering team and take ownership of designing, developing, and maintaining robust automated testing solutions.The ideal candidate is a strong hands-on automation engineer with solid experience in Java, Selenium, Typescript and Playwright, API testing, test framework development and CI/CD environments. You will work closely with developers, QA engineers and other stakeholders to ensure high-quality, reliable software releases.
 Key Responsibilities: 
Design, develop and maintain automated test frameworks and test suites for web applications
Mentor other automation engineers through pairing and code reviews
Maintain the existing automation framework using Java, Selenium and Playwright and Typescript for the new one
Create and maintain functional, regression, sanity and end-to-end automated tests
Perform API testing and automate REST API validation
Analyze test failures, troubleshoot issues and continuously improve test stability and reliability
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitLab
Contribute to automation architecture and identify opportunities to improve test coverage and execution efficiency
Collaborate closely with developers, QA engineers and business stakeholders to define testing approaches and priorities
Participate in code reviews and ensure automation code follows best practices
Generate and analyze test execution reports using tools such as Allure
Work with containerized and distributed environments, including Kubernetes, where required
Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, automation practices and tooling
Bring innovation to the team on the AI side: explore, pilot and roll out AI tools and practices that make writing tests easier and debugging faster
Use AI tools to write new tests faster, generate tests from user stories, and analyse logs and failures
Build reusable AI skills and prompts the whole team can use for writing and debugging tests
Analyse test execution results and historical data (e.g. Allure reports) to find the main causes of failure and recommend next steps
Continuously improve test stability and reliability, reducing flaky tests
 Requirements: 
5+ years of experience in QA Automation / SDET roles
Hands-on experience with Java or JavaScript
Strong practical experience with automation frameworks (Selenium or Playwright) is required
Experience with REST API testing and automation
Knowledge of TestNG, Maven and Git
Experience working with Jenkins and CI/CD pipelines
Experience developing or significantly contributing to automation frameworks from scratch
Hands-on, everyday use of AI tools in engineering work
Good understanding of software testing methodologies and QA best practices
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
Good communication and collaboration skills
 Benefits:
